Help protect Horowhenua's birdlife

The Ministry for Primary Industries (MPI) is leading New Zealand's response to H5 bird flu (H5N1). You can help protect our native birdlife and local poultry by knowing what to do. If you see three or more sick or dead wild birds together, please don't touch or move them. Report them to MPI and follow the latest advice.

View H5 bird flu information and reporting guidance

Nominations now open for Civic Awards and Youth Excellence Awards 2026

Published on July 31, 2026

Every community has them - the people whose leadership, service and quiet determination help shape Horowhenua for the better, the coach who stays late, the volunteer who never misses a working bee, or the young person already making their mark. Now is the time to put their name forward.

Kickstart your future with Horowhenua Tertiary Scholarship

Published on July 31, 2026

Horowhenua students getting ready for tertiary study in 2027, or continuing their studies next year, are encouraged to apply for Council’s Tertiary Education Scholarship. Applications open Friday 31 July 2026.

Community Grants and Funding Round 1 opens 1 August

Community groups, creatives and local organisations across Horowhenua are encouraged to start thinking about their next project, with applications for Community Grants and Funding Round 1 opening on 1 August 2026.
